items.issue: The opening undercover report, training company, publication date and alleged reverse-advertising comment response are not identified in the transcript.
items.disposition: Require the original report and comment evidence before treating the event as fact; otherwise attribute only to Mikey.

items.issue: Edited collages contain multiple small third-party social posts and chats whose authorship, order and wording cannot be recovered from sparse frames.
items.disposition: Densify 0-70 and 410-480 seconds if visual citations are needed; do not reconstruct missing text or expose private identifiers.

items.issue: The argument generalizes from selected online examples to a society-wide fall in tolerance, media incentives and gendered power.
items.disposition: Keep macro-causal claims on hold pending representative data and independent sources.

items.issue: Defending the legitimacy of learning dating skills could be misread as endorsing any tactic taught by a commercial provider.
items.disposition: Separate skill learning from deception, manipulation, pressure and consent violations; do not recommend the unidentified company or course.

items.issue: The video sometimes places clumsy pursuit, screenshot exposure and harassment accusations in one causal chain.
items.disposition: Preserve the distinction between awkwardness, rejection, boundary crossing and harassment; tolerance for awkwardness does not reduce consent requirements.

items.issue: Claims about men's motives, women's standards and the dating market use broad gender categories and moral language.
items.disposition: Do not generalize to all men or women; use only as Mikey's cultural critique after independent review.

items.issue: ASR corrupts several important phrases and platform terms.
items.disposition: Listen to original audio before exact quotation or naming the underlying event.
